query: mutation UpdateTemplateQuery($templateId: ID!, $newQuery: String!, $updateVariables: JSON) { updateTemplateQuery(templateId: $templateId, newQuery: $newQuery, updateVariables: $updateVariables) { success previousQuery template { id identifier name } errors { message } } }

variables.newQuery: query SearchTemplatesAdvanced($tags: [String!], $tagMatchMode: String = "ANY", $includeInactive: Boolean = false, $sortBy: String = "usageCount", $sortOrder: String = "DESC", $minUsageCount: Int, $maxUsageCount: Int, $createdAfter: String, $createdBefore: String, $searchText: String, $first: Int = 10, $after: String) { searchTemplates(tags: $tags, tagMatchMode: $tagMatchMode, includeInactive: $includeInactive, sortBy: $sortBy, sortOrder: $sortOrder, minUsageCount: $minUsageCount, maxUsageCount: $maxUsageCount, createdAfter: $createdAfter, createdBefore: $createdBefore, searchText: $searchText, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id identifier name description tags isActive usageCount avgExecutionTimeMs lastUsedAt createdAt updatedAt } totalCount hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } }
